Donate.faqReceiptQuestion: Will I receive a donation receipt?
Donate.faqReceiptAnswer: Yes — once your payment is verified, a receipt is generated and emailed to you automatically.
Donate.faqVerifyTimeAnswer: Our Finance team typically verifies bank transfer claims within a few working days of submission.
Donate.faqOnlineQuestion: Can I donate online with a card?
Donate.faqOnlineAnswer: Yes — use the "Donate Online" form above to pay securely by UPI, card, or net banking via Razorpay. If you would rather transfer directly, the bank/UPI details and confirmation form below are also available.
Donate.faqHistoryQuestion: Can I view my past donations?
Donate.faqHistoryAnswer: Yes — visit the Donation History page and log in with the email you donated with to receive a one-time code.
